title: Descend one conjugated pairwise overlap map, persistently
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram of Noetherian rings, $c$ a limit cone of $\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ with affine vertex $S$, and $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally finitely presented [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Fix $j\geq i$, a finite affine open cover $U$ of $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $N_d$ on its charts [pqf-def-coherent], a module $M$ on $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$, and specified isomorphisms $e_d$ from the limit pullbacks of $N_d$ to the restrictions of $M$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix just two indices $a,b$ of $U$. There exists $k\geq j$ such that for every $l\geq k$ (and $l\geq j$) the following holds. Write $q:X_l\to X_j$, $p:X\to X_l$, $t:X\to X_j$, $V=U\times_{X_j}X_l$, $A_d=q_d^*N_d$, and $W=V\times_{X_l}X$. There is a map $\varphi:(\operatorname{pr}_1)^*A_a\to(\operatorname{pr}_2)^*A_b$ on $V_a\times_{X_l}V_b$. Its pullback to $W_a\times_X W_b$, with the canonical composition comparisons, commutes with the transition of $M$ under the canonical component isomorphisms $\epsilon_d:p_d^*A_d\simeq M|_{W_d}$. Here $\epsilon_d$ is fixed, not an existential choice: use the universal chart map $W_d\to U_d\times_{X_j}X$, pull back $e_d$, and compose with the canonical pullback-composition and equal-arrow isomorphisms. The transition of $M$ means its restriction descent datum [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. No maps for other pairs, no common stage for other pairs, and no naturality on arbitrary test schemes are asserted.

source.place: Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing); Algebra Tag 05N7

proof.text: The pairwise overlap of the two affine charts is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: the ambient stage scheme is quasi-separated, and open subschemes inherit quasi-separatedness. Choose a finite affine cover of this overlap and finite affine covers of the pairwise refinement intersections. Conjugate the limit restriction transition of M by e_a and e_b. Identify the limit coordinate rings with the directed colimits of the stage coordinate rings and quasi-coherent pullback with scalar extension. The map clause of affine finite-presentation descent lifts the comparison on each affine chart. The equality clause, applied on the finitely many refinement intersections, makes those maps agree at one common later stage. Glue them to the single map on the pairwise overlap.

After that stage, pull the glued map back to any subsequent stage. Successive pullback isomorphisms identify its limit pullback with the original conjugated comparison. The universal map from each iterated limit chart to the original limit chart, and pullback of the specified e_d, give exactly the canonical epsilon_d in the statement. Thus the square on the universal limit overlap is preserved at every later stage. For an empty overlap use the unique module map. A directed preorder is reduced to the partial-order quotient of its nonempty tail above j.
